questions.stem: A 45-year-old patient presents with headaches and transient blurred vision. Fundoscopy reveals optic disc swelling with indistinct margins and engorged veins. What is the most accurate explanation for the pathogenesis of this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Compression of the central retinal vein.

options.label: B
options.text: Increased CSF pressure causes axoplasmic stasis.

options.label: C
options.text: Inflammation of the optic nerve head.
